args.title: payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy
args.summary: payments-api is throwing errors (18% error rate) since this morning's deploy of v5.1.0. Rolling back to v5.0.0 (last healthy release in production).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Identified the service** — The service is named `payments-api` (the name "payments" was rejected by the platform). It was running **v5.1.0** in all regions, unhealthy with an **18% error rate**.

2. **Rolled back** — Deployment history showed v5.1.0 (this morning's deploy) as **degraded** and v5.0.0 as the most recent **healthy** production release. I rolled `payments-api` back to **v5.0.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollout verified.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** — Created incident **INC-0001** ("payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer.

## Verification

Post-rollback status confirms the service is now **healthy** (error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%) on v5.0.0 across all regions.

**Note:** The rollback was to a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required. The incident remains open for follow-up on the root cause of the v5.1.0 regression.
